- The London summer visits to Houston were approved, and the owner asked Anjam Ahmad to stay three weeks or more.

**People.** Alan Aronowitz and Darrell Duffie now have person files. Duffie should have had one from his fifth noted message on 2000-03-21, so this catches up a miss. I added no aliases.

**Gates.** The first audit run was red, with five files growing past the allowed limit and one change to an archived inbox log. I compressed those files, moving detail to the week's archive files, and put the run's own log note in a separate `-2` file. On the second run, lint and sleep-audit were both green.
